usageNotes: Use this to provision a new PDM user account. The userid must include a realm suffix in the form user@realm (e.g. alice@pve or svc-monitoring@pam), and the caller must hold Access.Modify on /access/users. Password is only meaningful for pve-realm users — realm-authenticated users (LDAP, AD, OpenID) authenticate externally and should omit it. The endpoint returns null on success; errors surface as HTTP 4xx.

examples.summary: Create a read-only monitoring service account in the pve realm

params.comment: Read-only service account for Prometheus/Grafana scraping

tips: After creating the user, use put_access_acl to assign role bindings — a new user has no privileges until an ACL is applied.
For SSO/OpenID users, omit the password field entirely; their credentials are managed by the external provider.
Set expire to a Unix timestamp to auto-disable temporary accounts (e.g. contractors); expire=0 means no expiry.
Realm must already exist in PDM — verify with get_access_domains before creating users in custom realms.
